simple: A `TextBox` is a box where players can type, like a search bar, a name field, or a code entry pad. You can show it on the screen or on a part. Scripts can notice when the player finishes typing and then use what they wrote. Because players can type anything, you must filter their text before other people see it.
analogy: A `TextBox` is like a blank line on a form. The `PlaceholderText` is the light gray hint that says what to write, and it disappears when you start typing.
keyPoints: A `TextBox` lets a player type when it is in focus (selected).
`PlaceholderText` shows a hint, like "Enter your name", before the player types.
To add one to the screen: put a `ScreenGui` in `StarterGui`, then a `TextBox` in it.
To add one to a part: put a `SurfaceGui` in `StarterGui`, add the `TextBox`, then set the `SurfaceGui`'s `Adornee` to the part.
The `FocusLost` event fires when the player presses Enter or clicks away; its first value tells you if Enter was pressed.
`GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text")` lets you react every time the text changes, for example to allow only numbers.
You are responsible for filtering any text players type before showing it to others, or Roblox may remove your game.

terms.focus: When a text box is selected and ready for typing. Clicking the box gives it focus; pressing Enter or clicking away removes it.
terms.FocusLost: An event that fires when the box stops being selected.
terms.enterPressed: True if the player pressed Enter to finish, false if they just clicked somewhere else.
terms.PlaceholderText: Gray hint text shown when the box is empty.
terms.GetPropertyChangedSignal: Gives you an event that fires when one specific property changes, like `Text`.
terms.string.gsub: A function that finds and replaces parts of text. With the pattern `%D` it finds every character that is not a digit.
terms.text filtering: Roblox's system that hides bad words and personal info, like phone numbers, from text.

example.title: Read what the player typed when they press Enter
example.place: LocalScript inside a TextBox (inside a ScreenGui in StarterGui)
example.code:
local textBox = script.Parent
textBox.PlaceholderText = "Type a number and press Enter"

-- Only allow digits: remove anything that is not 0-9
local function allowOnlyNumbers()
	local cleaned = string.gsub(textBox.Text, "%D", "")
	if cleaned ~= textBox.Text then
		textBox.Text = cleaned
	end
end

local function onFocusLost(enterPressed)
	if enterPressed then
		print("You typed:", textBox.Text)
	end
end

textBox:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(allowOnlyNumbers)
textBox.FocusLost:Connect(onFocusLost)
explain: Every time the text changes, we remove any character that is not a digit using `string.gsub` and `%D`.
We only set `Text` again if something was removed, so we do not cause extra change events.
When the box loses focus, we check `enterPressed`; if the player pressed Enter, we print what they typed.

watchOut: Never show one player's typed text to other players without running it through Roblox's text filtering first.
`FocusLost` also fires when the player clicks away. Check `enterPressed` if you only want real submissions.
Text a player types in a `LocalScript` stays on their device. To use it on the server, you need to send it with a `RemoteEvent`.
